v.story-closed.intro.1.text: The first torn page landed in Closed Canyon, where every short vowel is shut in tight.

v.story-closed.intro.2.text: A consonant closes the door after a short vowel, like a latch on a gate.

v.story-closed.intro.3.text: Follow the wind into the canyon, and let's see what the walls can teach you.

v.story-closed.prologue.1.text: A storm tore through the library, and the Great Word Book flew off its shelf.

v.story-closed.prologue.2.text: Its pages blew across the land, and the words on them went quiet.

v.story-closed.prologue.3.text: The Keeper of Words said, 'I need an apprentice to read these words back into place. Will you help?'

v.story-closed.closed-review.1.text: The first torn page hides behind a rock, and short words will free it.

v.story-closed.closed-review.2.text: Read each short word one sound at a time, and the path opens up.

v.story-closed.closed-endings.1.text: A gust of wind pushes a page onto the trail, with a tiny ending stuck to it.

v.story-closed.closed-endings.2.text: Endings like -s, -es and -ed can stick to a word, like tags on a backpack.

v.story-closed.closed-compound.1.text: Two small words can hold hands to make one bigger word, like a bridge over a gully.

v.story-closed.closed-compound.2.text: Read each small word, then join them, and the bridge holds firm.

v.story-closed.closed-vccv-double.1.text: When two matching letters sit in the middle, the word splits between them.

v.story-closed.closed-vccv-double.2.text: A rabbit guards the trail, and its name has two matching letters in the middle.

v.story-closed.closed-vccv.1.text: Two different consonants stand in the middle, and the word breaks between them.

v.story-closed.closed-vccv.2.text: A camp cook dropped a napkin on the trail, and the split between nap and kin shows the way.

v.story-closed.closed-vcccv.1.text: Three consonants in the middle can look tricky, but keep a blend together, and otherwise split after the second consonant.

v.story-closed.closed-vcccv.2.text: A hundred stone steps climb the cliff, and you can read every one of them.

v.story-closed.closed-three.1.text: The last cliff holds a long word, but it is only three small closed pieces stacked together.

v.story-closed.closed-three.2.text: Split it into three parts, read each part, and then put the parts back together.

v.story-closed.finale.1.text: The first pages of the Great Word Book glow, and the canyon walls are steady again.

v.story-closed.finale.2.text: The Keeper smiles and says, 'Closed Canyon is clear. Next, the islands where open sounds sing.'
